description: This file contains class definitions and implementations for streaming client and producer objects used in Orleans streaming tests, including observer patterns, grain proxies, and factories for creating and managing streaming consumer and producer grains.

classes.name: Streaming_ConsumerClientObject
classes.description: Implements IAsyncObserver and IStreaming_ConsumerGrain for consuming streaming items, managing consumer state with a cluster client.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerClientObject
classes.description: Implements IStreaming_ProducerGrain for producing streaming items, with methods for starting/stopping production and querying status.

classes.name: ConsumerProxy
classes.description: A proxy class managing multiple consumer grains, providing methods to become consumers, gather metrics, and manage lifecycle in a test environment.

classes.name: ProducerProxy
classes.description: A proxy class managing multiple producer grains, handling production tasks, lifecycle management, and gathering metrics.

methods.name: NewObserver
methods.description: Factory method to create new Streaming_ConsumerClientObject instances.

methods.name: NewObserver
methods.description: Factory method to create new Streaming_ProducerClientObject instances.

methods.name: NewConsumerProxy
methods.description: Creates a ConsumerProxy instance, initializing consumer grains for a stream.

methods.name: NewConsumerGrainsAsync
methods.description: Creates multiple consumer grains asynchronously with optional deduplication.

methods.name: NewProducerProxy
methods.description: Initializes a ProducerProxy with producer grains for a stream.

methods.name: NewProducerGrainsAsync
methods.description: Creates multiple producer grains asynchronously.

methods.name: NewProducerConsumerGrainsAsync
methods.description: Creates producer/consumer grain pairs with optional reentrant behavior.

methods.name: NewConsumerClientObjectsAsync
methods.description: Creates multiple consumer client objects for a stream.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Targets all consumer grains to start consuming a specified stream.

methods.name: ProduceSequentialSeries
methods.description: Produces a sequence of items across all target producer grains in series.

methods.name: ProduceParallelSeries
methods.description: Produces a sequence of items across all target producer grains in parallel.

methods.name: ProducePeriodicSeries
methods.description: Starts producing items periodically on all producer grains.

methods.name: AddNewConsumerGrain
methods.description: Adds a new consumer grain and returns its GUID.

methods.name: GetExpectedItemsProduced
methods.description: Returns the total expected number of items that will be produced.

methods.name: GetProducerCount
methods.description: Returns total number of producer grains.

methods.name: StopBeingProducer
methods.description: Stops all producer grains from producing items.

methods.name: VerifyFinished
methods.description: Verifies all producers have finished producing.

methods.name: DeactivateProducerOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates producer grains when idle.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Stops consumer grains from consuming items.

methods.name: DeactivateConsumerOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates consumer grains when idle.

methods.name: GetNumActivations
methods.description: Returns activation counts for a set of grains.
